title: USER MANUAL / STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE
meta: Client Site: Deniz Construction Limited, Ishanyu Bushenyi Road, Mbarara

blocks.text: This manual guides the Sales Manager through daily operations using the Deniz Construction Management System (DCMS). It covers two workflows: processing sales during the day and reconciling accounts in the evening.
Primary user: Sales Manager (supervisor, cashier, payroll distributor, record keeper). Secondary: Business Owner (views daily summary report).
DCMS runs on the existing office laptop. It operates offline during the day and syncs to cloud backup each evening after reconciliation. No internet required for daily sales.

items: Turn on the office laptop.
Double-click the DCMS icon on the desktop.
The Home Dashboard opens showing two main buttons: Daily Sales and End of Day Reconciliation.
Enter your User ID (provided by Group K during setup).
Enter your password.
Click Login. The system remembers you for the day.

blocks.text: Use this workflow each time a customer buys blocks, pavers or kerbs. The system prints a physical receipt immediately.

items: From the Home Dashboard click Daily Sales.
The New Sale screen opens with empty fields.
Tap the Product dropdown.
Choose the category: Solid Blocks, Hollow Blocks, Pavers or Kerbs.
Select the exact item from the list:
Solid Blocks: 4×8×16, 6×8×16, 8×8×16 inches
Hollow Blocks: 4×8×16, 6×8×16, 8×8×16 inches
Pavers: 60mm Interlocking, 60mm Rectangular, 60mm Hexagonal, 80mm Interlocking, 80mm Rectangular, 80mm Hexagonal
Kerbs: Garden, Road
Enter the quantity sold (pieces, square metres or bundles as shown).
The Unit Price fills automatically from the product catalogue.
Verify the Subtotal = Quantity × Unit Price.
Choose one: Cash, Mobile Money or Bank Deposit.
If Mobile Money: enter the transaction reference number.
If Bank Deposit: enter the deposit slip number.
Tap Save Sale.
The system instantly calculates 18% VAT and shows the Total.
A physical receipt prints automatically on the attached printer.
Hand the receipt to the customer.
A successful save records all sale lines and reduces stock. Check the payment total for the selected business date. If stock is insufficient, correct the quantities before trying again.
From the Home Dashboard click View Sales.
Find the incorrect sale by Receipt ID.
Use Void for an entry error on an open date when no money was received and no goods were released. Enter the reason.

The original receipt stays in the history. If money was returned or the sale date is already closed, record a linked adjustment on an open date. For a full refund, confirm the original payment was returned through the same channel and record which goods came back into stock.

blocks.text: Run this once per day before the Business Owner arrives. It shows recorded payment activity by channel, reconciles physical cash and produces the Daily Summary Report.

items: From the Home Dashboard click End of Day Reconciliation.
Select the open business date. The screen shows recorded activity for Cash, Mobile Money and Bank Deposit.

blocks.text: 4.2 Review Payment Activity and Count Cash

items: Review the recorded total for each payment method. Enter the opening cash float if one was carried. Expected cash includes the opening float and net cash activity, less logged cash expenses.
For Cash: count the physical cash in the drawer.
Enter the Actual Cash Counted.
The system computes Variance = Actual minus Expected.
Click Add Expense.
Enter description (e.g. Loader lunch, Transport fare, Boda-boda).
Enter amount paid from the Cash drawer.
Click Save. Expected cash and the variance are recalculated for the selected date.
If Variance is not zero, the system requires a text explanation.
Type the reason (e.g. Unrecorded petty cash, Counting error).
You can leave the explanation blank if the variance is zero.
Review the Daily Summary Report preview.
Click Close Day.
The system saves the final report and closes the selected business date. Use the saved report if you need to review it again.
An encrypted cloud backup runs automatically.
The report is ready for the Business Owner's morning review.
Operational Metrics: Total Trucks Dispatched, Total Blocks Sold, Total Workers Present.
Financial Summary: Net Payment Activity by Channel, Opening Cash, Operational Expenses, Expected Cash, Actual Cash, Variance, Notes.

blocks.text: The Business Owner reviews this each morning.

items: From Home Dashboard click Attendance.
Tap the green check icon next to each worker name to mark Present.
Tap again to unmark if mistake.
Click Save. The list feeds the Daily Summary Report and payroll.

rows: Check power, paper roll and USB cable. Restart printer.
Restart laptop. Ensure DCMS shortcut points to correct folder.
VAT rate is 18% from System Settings. Do not edit manually.
Check internet. Backup retries automatically when online.
Contact Group K for reset. No self-reset for security.
